what: AR53, the goals' look, for TR54: research's pick B (2026-11-23, 17:49) with its must-fix 1 and the fall's card. Every word is TR54's (docs/test-requests.md, TR54: the dares, today's three, the Ledger's lines, Next, the labels): this file holds where words sit, never the words.
units: points at the smallest phone (568 x 320); every box is left, top, width, height; a word's y is its capitals' top; images at 4 pixels a point, edge alpha 0. An image's `origin` is where its lay point sits in it, in points from its top left (times 4 for pixels): a lay's `origin` is where that point goes

line.note: the run's line as StageController builds it; boxes from the line's glass's top left

unfolded.held: about 3 s from the stretch's start (a seed: TR54's Config), then it folds

tab.make: the line's own glass, under it, corners cut 4

folded.broken: the tag's image swaps to DareTagDark; no words, no sound
folded.kept: DareTagKept once, as the stretch clears

line.hard: the same row and tab in the Hard line's glass (the ember's edge)

tags.origin: 7 right of stretch k's mark's right edge, 2 under the road's middle, for each k kept

chip.row: last on the time's row, the row's gap (8) before it; on the fall's card a row of its own under the line that says where the next run starts, 26 tall, the chip centred, 2 down

stone.make: the kit's Common item cell with the forge stone's picture of the ground's grade (StoneLow on Lantern Row) at 0.94 and a hairline in the edge #E2CFA4 over its rim, as Reinforce draws its stone

chip.widest: with a new best the row is about 297 of the card's 320 by the sheet's letter widths: not measured in the game's face, so the first capture checks it

card.none: no dare kept: no tag, no chip, on either card

today.note: boxes from Home's glass's top left (build/handoff/UI/home_cards/home_cards.json). HomeSettings, HomeSettingsPress and the Settings label leave the panel: Settings is the cog tile

card.waits: HomeTodayWaits shows while any goal, today's or banked, waits to be claimed

shard.image: the Lantern Row shard's small picture (shard_standard_small)

pips.note: today's three in the lists' order: fight, base, roster

word.make: Home's words: bold, leaning, a soft dark under

list.note: in the glass alone: the three cards, the cog tile and the Today card hidden, HomeGlass and HomePointer kept

ledger.tap: at least 44 each way; the Ledger's one way in at launch

rows.origin: a row's top, its foot's left corner
rows.done: the whole row is the claim's press

ledger.note: a Seam page in the Stages screen's make (its glass, wells, quiet plate and road); boxes on the phone

next.make: the quiet plate, its edge the facet

lines.note: the step, then what it opens: TR54's line split at its first full stop; the last line stands alone

rail.chosen: the card's shade, the light's hairline 1.4, its glow

mask.lit: once one of its kind has fallen

wall.make: a tile's glass; unlit, the channel over it at 0.3

mask.note: lit, then unlit; the knot is the origin, the tilt is in the image

count.note: the number and its label centred together under the name

says.entry: each line's badge, words, road and rule are measured from its own top: first + k x pitch

road.shows: on the first line not reached, filled to count / need

rule.under: the first and the second line

DareTag.use: the dare's tag, lit while the dare holds

DareTagKept.use: the dare's tag, its flare, kept

DareTagDark.use: the dare's tag, dark once broken
